openingLine: I am done. Timur replaced my module without even asking me, and I am thinking of leaving the team.

turns.text: That sounds really unfair, what happened last night?
turns.characterLine: He replaced the whole module and told everyone afterward. How do I know this will not happen again?

turns.text: From now on nobody changes someone's module without their review.
turns.characterLine: That review rule would help. But which version do we keep now, and who is fixing the broken login?

turns.text: You finish the payments endpoint, Timur fixes login, we freeze on Thursday.
turns.characterLine: I can do that. But the Thursday run just failed, and we still have two screens unfinished. What now?

turns.text: Let's cut one screen, take shifts, and nobody stays past midnight.
turns.characterLine: Okay. I can stay if we protect the team and keep the work fair. Let us finish this together.
